limits: Trust frozen before raw artifact access, after CI measurements began.

Raw physical IPC inputs and all four own-arm golden arrays are replayed independently. All four arms’ query golden arrays are retained at both thread settings and independently replayed. Timed final arrays are not duplicated: exact source-bound final checks/hashes are bound to each arm golden. All four complete corpus arrays are independently replayed.
C corpus uses historical tolerance1e-10, integer outputs exact; native corpus requires exact finite/signed-zero/masks/NaN positions. NaN sign/payload not a public guarantee.

Shared-target Cargo metadata/fingerprints/dependency edges/portable flags are inspected but are not a unique cryptographic ELF-to-linked-rlib bridge; source/wheel binding includes exact actual compile logs and immutable workflow execution.
Twelve process rounds and correlated inner samples are descriptive, not formal multiple-comparison significance; no pooling thread settings/runners.
Fault counters cover engine/Python/allocator activity across query threads, not allocator-only events.

SAREXT numerical outputs are compared against retained immutable original C/public native goldens; no separate reimplementation of the SAR kernel is executed by this auditor. Physical inputs, grouping, warmups, C-target zero boundary, pure Polars controls and all distributions are independently reconstructed.

Timed final output arrays are not duplicated; immutable child source performs exact final checks against own-arm goldens, with retained pre-timer output hashes and final_output_checked flag. No timing-loop instrumentation or allocator-only attribution.
